home.cardExpensesInfoBody1: Zvese zvakabhadhariswa kumakadhi ako echikwereti mwedzi uno - swipe, kutenga pamhepo, mubhadharo weUPI wakaitwa pakadhi. Kuti uone imwe neimwe, vhura Mari uye sarudza Kadhi sefa.
home.cardExpensesInfoBody2: Kushandisa kadhi hakuna kumbowedzerwa kumari yebhangi pamusoro. Mari iyoyo haisati yabuda mubhangi rako; inosiya paunobhadhara chikwereti.
home.billPaidInfoBody1: Mari yakasvika kumakadhi ako echikwereti mwedzi uno ikagadzirisa zvawakanga washandisa kare. Kuti uone kubhadhara kwega kwega, vhura Mari uye sarudza iyo Kadhi sefa.
home.billPaidInfoBody2: Bhiri rakabhadharwa kubva kubhangi rako zvakare rinoverengerwa mumari yebhangi, nekuti iyo mari yakasiya account yako. Hazvina kumbowedzerwa kumari yemakadhi - izvo zvinoshandiswa zvakaverengerwa pazuva rawakazviita.
home.billPaidInfoBody3: Kubhadharwa kuburikidza nemamwe mapurogiramu? Mari yasvika pakadhi inoratidzwa pano, ukuwo mari yekubhadharisa mari inoramba iri mumari yebhangi pasi pezita reapp iyoyo, saka hapana chinoverengwa kaviri.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody1: Zvese zvakasiya mabhengi ako nemaakaundi emari mwedzi uno: UPI uye makadhi-yemahara kubhadhara, cheki, kubviswa kweATM, kumira mirairo, uye chero chawakawedzera nemaoko. Imwe neimwe inoverengera pazuva rayo, uye kubaya mataira anonyora ese.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody2: Kushandiswa kwekadhi rechikwereti hakuverengwe pano. Ndeyekadhi kusvika waigadzirisa, saka inogara mumutsara weKiredhiti kadhi pazasi panzvimbo - iyo mari ichiri muakaundi yako.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody3: Mari yekadhi rechikwereti yakabhadharwa kubva kubhangi rako inoverengwa pano, pazuva rayakasiya account. Ndiyo nguva iyo kushandiswa kwekadhi kunopedzisira kwasvika kubhangi rako, uye inoverengwa kamwe chete: semari yebhangi, isingazombofi zvakare semubhadharo wekadhi.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody4: Kuendesa mari kune imwe yako maakaundi zvakare kunokosha, nekuti yakanyatsosiya iyi. Iyo account yakaigamuchira inorekodha mari inoenderana, saka chiyero chako hachina kuchinjwa.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody5: Maakaundi amaka seasingabatanidzwe anosiiwa zvachose, uye ndizvo zvakaitawo chero chinhu chakanyorwa kunze kwemwedzi uno.
home.sumCardBillsPaid: zvikwereti zvekadhi rechikwereti zvakabhadharwa kubva mairi
home.sumBankExpensesNote: Ichi ndicho chikonzero nhamba yacho inogona kutaridzika yakakura mumwedzi wawakabhadhara bhiri: bhiri imari kunze kwebhangi, kunyange iwe wakaishandisa kare.
home.sumEverythingSpentNote: Bhiri rawakabhadhara rinogara mukati memutsara wekutanga, sezvo mari iyi yakasiya bhangi rako mwedzi uno. Kadhi rinopedza mari yacho raiverengerwa pakadhi mumwedzi wawakagadzira, saka bhiri rekushandisa mari yakare rinoverengwa mumwedzi uno pamwe chete neuyu.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody1: Zvese zvakasvika mubhangi rako nemaakaundi emari mwedzi uno: muhoro, mubereko, kudzorera, mari yakagamuchirwa pamusoro peUPI, uye chero chawakawedzera nemaoko. Tinya tile kuti uone imwe neimwe.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody2: Mari yakapinzwa kubva kune imwe account yako inoverengwa, nekuti iyi account yakaiwana. Iyo account yawabva inotakura mari inofananidzwa.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody3: Mubhadharo unosvika kadhi rako rechikwereti haisi mari. Inobvisa zvaunokwereta pakadhi, saka zvinoita sekunge Bhiri rakabhadharwa mumutsara wekadhi rechikwereti pazasi.
home.sumBalanceNote: Zvakasiya maakaunti ako zvinosanganisira kiredhiti kadhi rechikwereti rawakabhadhara mwedzi uno, ndosaka mwedzi uine bhiri inogona kubuda yakaderera pane yaunonzwa.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody1: Mari inotambirwa nebhanga mwedzi uno inobvisa mari yekubhanga yemwedzi uno. Hapana chimwe chiri mairi, saka nhamba mbiri dziri padivi payo dzinogara dzichiwedzera kune ino.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody2: Haisi mari yawakabata nhasi. Chero maakaunti ako akatakurwa kubva mumwedzi yapfuura haisi chikamu chayo - vhura Maakaundi kuti uone iwo anomhanya matomu.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody3: Nhamba iri pazasi zero inongoreva zvakawanda zvakasiya maakaundi ako mwedzi uno pane zvasvika, izvo zvinowanzoitika kana bhiri rechikwereti chemari yekushandisa kare rawira mariri.

settings.restoreWarnBody:
Ngenisa zvigadziriso zvemafambisirwo uye mabhajeti chete ehuwandu hwemazuva mufaira. Data iri kunze kweiyo range iri pafoni iyi inoramba iripo. 

Maakaundi: anodzoserwa kubva mufaira chete kana foni iyi isati yaita zvekutengesa (semuenzaniso mushure mekuiswazve). Zvikasadaro maakaundi ako azvino anogara. 

Iwe unozobvunzwa kana uchitsiva zviyeuchidzo uye rondedzero yekutenga. 

Kana Premium gore sync iripo, iyo yakasanganiswa mhedzisiro inowirirana (yekupedzisira ~ makore maviri mugore).

faq.aAddTxn:
Bhatani re + riri pakati pebhawa rezasi rinovhura Wedzera Transaction kubva chero kupi muapp. Sarudza Mari kana Mari, tora chikamu chayo, wobva waisa huwandu uye zuva.

Yakabhadharwa ne / Yakagamuchirwa mukati pane imwechete skrini inosarudza iyo account iyo mari inosiya kana inogara mukati, saka sarudza iyo chaiyo kana iwe ukachengeta anopfuura imwe account. Iwe unofanirwa kusaina kuti uchengetedze.
faq.qCardTxn: Ndinorekodha sei kushandisa kadhi rechikwereti kana kubhadhara bhiri remakadhi?
faq.aCardTxn:
Iyo Kadhi rechikwereti tebhu muAdd Transaction inoonekwa kana wava nekadhi rechikwereti. Inopa zvinhu zviviri: Mari yekadhi rechikwereti kune chimwe chinhu chawakatenga pakadhi, uye kiredhiti kadhi rechikwereti chekubhadhara kwaunoita kukambani yemakadhi.

Kuvaparadzanisa kunokosha. Chikwereti chemakadhi chinotorwa semari inofamba kubva kubhangi rako kuenda kune kadhi, kwete semari yechipiri, saka kubhadhara mari hakurevi kushandiswa kwakafanana kaviri.
faq.aEditTxn:
Vhura runyorwa rwekutengeserana kubva kuOngorora mutsara pachiratidziro chekutanga - kubaya Mari kana Mari inokwana ipapo inokuendesa kune imwechete rondedzero. Tinya kutengeserana kuti uvhure ruzivo rwayo, wobva waRongedza, shandura izvo zvisirizvo, uye Gadzirisa.

Iwe unogona kushandura huwandu, chikamu, zuva, chinyorwa uye account. Rondedzero inongoratidza mwedzi wawakasarudza, saka enda kumwedzi iwoyo kutanga kana kutengeserana kwakura.
faq.aDeleteTxn:
Tinya kutengeserana kuri murondedzero kuti uvhure ruzivo rwayo, wobva wadzima. Inokukumbira kuti usimbise kutanga, nekuti kutengeserana kwakadzimwa hakugone kudzoserwa.

Kudzima kadhi rekubhadhara bhiri rinobvisa mativi ose maviri kamwechete, saka bhangi nekadhi zvese zvinodzokera kune zvazvaive.
faq.aDeleteMany:
Zvese zvekutengesa ndiyo chete rondedzero ine zvikwekwe mabhokisi. Tinya mutsara wega wega waunoda, kana shandisa Sarudza zvese pane zvese zvaratidzwa, wobva wadzima uye simbisa. Bhawa riri pazasi rinochengeta zvaunenge watora.

Gadzirisa gore, mwedzi uye mafirita ezuva kumusoro kutanga - ndiyo nzira inokurumidza kujekesa mwedzi mumwe, uye inoita kuti Sarudza zvese kubva pakutora kutengeserana kwawaida kuchengeta.
faq.aTheme:
Themes inonyora ese eseti yemavara, uye kubaya imwe inoishandisa pese pese nekukasira - hapana kutangazve, uye hapana chimwe chinochinja.

Mamwe madingindira akamisikidzwa ePrimum. Kana iwe ukasanyoresa, unogona kuvhura imwe ine madhaimani kubva kuDiamonds skrini panzvimbo.
faq.qAvatar: Ndinoshandura sei mufananidzo wangu kana kusarudza munhu?
faq.aAvatar:
Mufananidzo wako unogara paProfile Yangu. Tinya, wobva wasarudza Classic - yako yekutanga muruvara rwedingindira - kana imwe yemavara e3D.

Mavara ePrimum ekuwedzera, uye anogona zvakare kuvhurwa nemadhaimani kwemazuva mashoma. Iyo Diamonds skrini inoratidza mutengo uye kuti kuvhura kunotora nguva yakareba sei.
faq.aAppLock:
Kukiya kweApp kunoshandisa zvigunwe, kumeso kana skrini kukiya iyo foni yatove nayo, saka hapana yakaparadzana password yekurangarira uye hapana chakawedzerwa chakachengetwa. Kuibatidza kunokumbira kuti usimbise kamwe chete, kuve nechokwadi kuti inoshanda.

Mushure meizvozvo app inobvunza kuti unoivhura rinhi, uye zvakare paunodzokera kwairi mushure mechinguva - kwete pese paunotarisa pachiziviso. Kana iwe ukazobvisa kukiya chidzitiro kubva parunhare, iyo app inomira kubvunza pane kukuvhara iwe kunze kwemarekodhi ako.
faq.aLanguage:
Mutauro unoronga mitauro yese iyo app inowanikwa mairi. Tokonya imwe uye app yese inochinja ipapo ipapo, kusanganisira iyi FAQ.

Mazwi emutemo muMitemo Yekushandisa uye Privacy Policy anoramba ari muChirungu, sezvo iri iro shanduro inoshanda zviri pamutemo. Zvimwe zvese zvinoturikirwa.
faq.qImportSms: Ndinoshandura sei SMS yangu yebhangi kuita matransaction?
faq.aImportSms:
Kutenga kunze kwenyika kunoverenga mameseji ekubhangi agara ari pafoni iyi pamwedzi waunosarudza, uye inonyora zvayakaona semari, mari uye kubhadhara kwemakadhi. Isa iwo aunoda, gadzirisa chero chikamu, wobva wawedzera kutengeserana.

Mameseji anoverengwa parunhare uye haambopirwe. Chese chatotengwa kunze kwenyika chakamakwa saka haugone kuchiwedzera kaviri. Kuverenga SMS ndeye Android chete - Apple hairegi chero app ichiita.
faq.qAutoImport: MaSMS ekubhengi angawedzerwa here ini ndisina kuvapinza munyika nguva dzese?
faq.aAutoImport:
Ehe. Batidza Wedzera ivo otomatiki pane iyo Import transactions skrini uye mameseji anofananidzwa anove ekuita ega pese paunovhura app.

Yakadzima kusvikira waibatidza, inoda kuwanikwa kweSMS kuti itenderwe kare, uye inongomhanya apo app yakavhurika. Iyo imwe skrini ichiri kunyora zvese, saka iwe unokwanisa kutarisa zvayakawedzera uye kudzima chero chawanga usingade.
faq.qAddAccount: Ndinowedzera sei akaundi yekubhangi kana kadhi rechikwereti?
faq.aAddAccount:
Maakaundi anobata kwese kwakagara mari yako. Shandisa + Wedzera account, ipe zita, isa izvo zviri mairi nhasi sechiyero chekutanga, uye sarudza rudzi - Bhengi / Cash / Debit Kadhi, kana Chikwereti Kadhi.

Rudzi urwu ndirwo runoita kuti kadhi mari isashandise kubva mubhangi rako, saka kadhi rechikwereti rinofanira kuwedzerwa seKiredhiti Kadhi kwete seakaundi yekubhangi.
faq.qEditAccount: Ini ndinopa zita kana kudzima account sei?
faq.aEditAccount:
Imwe neimwe kadhi reakaundi pane iyo Accounts skrini ine Rongedza zita, kutanga chiyero uye mhando, uye Delete iyo account pachayo.

Imwe account yekubhangi uye kadhi rechikwereti zvinogara zvichisara, chero zvawazvitumidza, saka yekupedzisira yega yega haigone kudzimwa. Wedzera chinotsiva kutanga uye chekare chigozoenda.
faq.qCategory: Ndinowedzera sei kana kupa zita rechikwata?
faq.aCategory:
Zvikamu zvine tab yeMari uye imwe yeMari. Tinya chero chikamu kuti uipezve zita kana kushandura iyo icon uye ruvara, kana shandisa + Wedzera chikamu chemutengo pazasi kune chitsva.

Kupa zita patsva kunotakura zvinhu zvekare uye bhajeti rayo, saka hapana chiri nherera. Kudzima chikamu kunofambisa chero chakashandiswa kune Vamwe, uye Mamwe pachawo haagone kudzimwa.
faq.qBudget: Ndinoisa sei bhajeti remwedzi wega wega?
faq.aBudget:
Iyo Budget tab ndipo panogara miganhu. Tinya SET BUDGET, sarudza chikamu, isa huwandu uye chengetedza. Budget yega yega inozoratidza bhawa rekuti wapedza marii mwedzi uno.

Iyo ⋮ iri pakadhi rebhajeti inoita kuti ugadzirise kana kuibvisa, uye Copy kubva pamwedzi wapfuura inounza miganho yemwedzi wapfuura kumberi panzvimbo yekuinyora zvakare.
faq.aReminder:
Vhura Zviyeuchidzo kubva mumutsara uri pamusoro pematabo uye sarudza rudzi rwaunoda: zviyeuchidzo zvebhiri kana mari, mishonga, mazuva ekupera kwegirosari, kana chinyorwa. Imwe neimwe ine Nyowani tebhu kwaunozadza izvo uye chengetedza.

Zviyeuchidzo zvinosvika sezviziviso zvefoni, saka zvinosvika kwauri neapp yakavharwa. Izvo zvinoda mvumo yekuzivisa, iyo app inokumbira kamwe chete, uye nhare dzinobata bhatiri zvine hukasha dzinogona kuramba dzakadzora yambiro. Kuti zviyeuchidzo zvinoita ruzha kana kudedera zviri kwauri mune maAlarms & zviziviso.
faq.aBuyList:
Tenga runyorwa, mumutsara uri pamusoro pematabo, ndeyezvinhu zvaunoronga kutenga. Nyora chinhu uye uwandu, wowedzera, uye womaka chimwe nechimwe pachitoro.

Iyo inoramba iine rondedzero pachayo: kutara chinhu hakugadziri muripo, uye hakutumire chero chinhu kuzviyeuchidzo.
faq.aSplit:
Kupatsanura, mumutsara uri pamusoro pematabo, inochengeta mari yakagovaniswa. Wedzera shamwari kana boka kutanga, wobva wawedzera mari paTebhu yeMari, sarudza anoigovera, wochengeta. Zviyero zvinoratidza kuti ndiani ane chikwereti cheuyo mushure mezvose zvinoverengwa.

Split chinhu chePrimum, saka chinokukumbira kuti uone zvirongwa kana account yako isina.
faq.aCharts:
Iyo maChati tebhu inotyora mwedzi wakasarudzwa pasi nechikamu semhete, uye inogona kuratidza mari panzvimbo pezvinoshandiswa. Shandura gore, mwedzi kana zuva kumusoro kuti utarise imwe nguva.

Iyo Budget tebhu inopindura imwe hafu yayo - izvo zvawakaronga kushandisa uchipesana nezvawakanyatso shandisa.
faq.aBackup:
Backup data inonyora zvese - zvekutengesa, maakaunti, mabhajeti, zviyeuchidzo uye rondedzero yekutenga - mufaira rimwe raunogona kutumira kwauri kana kuchengeta mukuchengetedza gore.

Ita izvi usati wachinja mafoni kana kuisa zvakare app. Backup chinhu chePrimum. Export Data chinhu chakasiyana: spreadsheet kuverenga, kwete faira iwe unogona kudzorera kubva.
faq.qRestore: Ndinodzosa sei data rangu pane imwe foni itsva?
faq.aRestore:
Isa iyo app, saina neakaundi imwe chete, wobva washandisa Dzosera backup uye tora faira rawakachengeta.

Kudzoreredza kunotsiva izvo zviri muapp izvozvi, saka zvinokuyambira zvisati zvaenda kumberi. Kana iwe wanga uine Premium ine gore sync pa, yako data inodzoka pakusaina-isina faira zvachose.
faq.aSignIn:
Kusaina neGoogle ndiko kunoita kuti app ichengetedze chero chinhu. Pasina iyo unogona kutarisa-tarisa, asi kuwedzera nekugadzirisa kwakavharwa, uye hapana chinochengetwa.

Inosungirawo data rako kwauri kwete kufoni, saka foni yakarasika haifanire kureva marekodhi akarasika.
faq.aSignOut:
Log inogara pazasi peProfile skrini uye inokukumbira kuti usimbise.

Kubuda hakudzime chero chinhu. Pinda neakaundi imwechete uye data rako riripo zvakare. Kuti ubvise data rako pachinzvimbo, shandisa Delete data yese mumaseting eApp.
faq.aPremium:
Nhengo yePrimum paProfile skrini inovhura kuenzanisa, iyo inonyora ese maficha uye inomaka izvo zvemahara uye izvo zvinoda chirongwa. Muchidimbu: kuwiriranisa kwegore, kuchengetedza faira uye kudzoreredza, kupatsanura mari, Smart Insights, ese madingindira uye hunhu maavatars, uye hapana ads.

Zvese zvekuita nekutevera mari zuva nezuva - kutengeserana, maakaundi, mabhajeti, machati, zviyeuchidzo, rondedzero yekutenga uye kutumira kweSMS - ndeye mahara.
faq.aDiamonds:
Madhaimani anowanwa nekuona vhidhiyo pfupi, kusvika mashoma pazuva, uye anoshandiswa paDiamonds skrini kuvhura zvinhu pasina kubhadhara: dingindira, hunhu avatar, kana kupasa kunochinja maPrimum maficha kwenhamba yakatarwa yemazuva.

Kupfuura kwedhaimani hakubvisi kushambadza - kushambadza ndiko kunowana madhaimondi. Kukoka shamwari kunowanawo mari.
faq.qHomeMonth: Sei huwandu hwemwedzi nemwedzi hweapp husingaenderane nebhangi rangu rebhangi?
faq.aHomeMonth:
Yekutanga skrini ishumo pamwedzi wauri kutarisa: Mari inodiwa uye Mari inokwana mwedzi iwoyo, uye Balance ndeimwe kubvisa imwe. Haisi mari yaunayo.

Chaunonyatso kubata chiri pachiratidziro cheAccounts, chinoverenga mwedzi wega wega pamwe chete neakaundi yega yega yekutanga chiyero. Mutsara wekadhi rechikwereti unoshanda nenzira imwechete - chii chakashandiswa pakadhi mwedzi uno, uye chii chakabhadharwa kwairi.
faq.qContact: Ndinoshuma sei dambudziko kana kukumbira chimiro?
faq.aContact:
Mhinduro mumagadzirirwo eApp inotumira meseji kwatiri, uye yekutanga skrini ine Taura nyaya uye Kumbira chimiro chechinhu chimwe chete.

Kutaura kuti wanga uri papi skrini uye zvawaitarisira pane kudaro zvinoita kuti dambudziko rikurumidze kuwana. Rubatsiro uye Mitemo Yekushandisa inovhara kuti chikamu chega chega cheapp chinoitirwa kushanda sei.

terms.guide3Body:
Zvikamu zviri pazasi zvinofamba nechero chinhu muhurongwa hwaungangosangana nazvo, kubva kuChiratidziro cheKumba kusvika kuaccount yako uye data. Imwe neimwe inotsanangura zvinoitwa nechinhu uye maitiro ayo, saka iwe unoziva zvauri kubvuma kushandisa.

Mamwe maficha anogona kudzimwa, kutengwa nemitengo zvakasiyana, kana kuburitswa zvishoma nezvishoma nemuparidzi, saka zvaunoona muApp rinogara riri izwi rekupedzisira. Mari nemitengo yakadomwa pano ndeyekusarudzika uye inogona kuchinja.
terms.guide31Body:
Bhendi riri pamusoro peKumba rinoratidza Mari, Mari uye Balance yemwedzi wazvino wekarenda. Kudzvanya Mari kana Mari inovhura iyo inoenderana rondedzero.

Paunenge uine kadhi rechikwereti, mutsara wechipiri unogara pasi nenhamba mbiri dzemwedzi: zvawakabhadharisa makadhi ako, uye zvawakabhadhara kumabhiri avo. Kadhi rechikwereti rawakabhadhara rinoverengwawo semari kubva muakaunti yakaribhadhara, saka mitsara miviri pamwe chete inoverengera zvese zvawakashandisa.

Iwe unogona kuvanza pfupiso bhendi, sarudza kana Imba ichivhura paMari kana Mari, uye woisa magadzirirwo anorongwa, muApp Settings pasi peKumba peji.
terms.guide32Body:
Bhatani re + rinovhura fomu rekuwedzera. Sarudza Mari, Mari kana Kadhi rechikwereti, sarudza chikamu, wobva waisa iyo mari, iyo account yayakabva kana kuenda kwairi, zuva, uye imwe sarudzo.

Unogona kubatanidza mufananidzo webhiri kune kutengeserana. Zvinyorwa zvegirosari zvinogona kuputswa kuita zvinhu zvega zvine mazuva ekupera, izvo zvinogona kusimudza zviyeuchidzo zvegirosari kwauri otomatiki.

Chero chekutengesa chinogona kugadziridzwa kana kudzimwa gare gare nekudzvanya pane rondedzero.
terms.guide33Body:
Kadhi rechikwereti haisi hari yemari, saka App inoichengeta yakaparadzana kubva kumaakaundi ane mari chaiyo. Zvaunochaja kune kadhi imari pakadhi, uye "Credit card bhiri" inorekodha kubhadhara kadhi kubva sekutamiswa kubva kuakaundi yakabhadhara kune kadhi.

Bhiri rinoverengwa semari kubva muakaunti yekubhadhara, nepo munhu anoshandisa kugara akaverengerwa pakadhi, saka mari imwe chete haiverengerwe kaviri. Musha uye pfupiso yeTransaction inoratidza nhamba dzese dzemwedzi: inobhadhariswa pakadhi, uye yakabhadharwa kwairi.

Iyo App haiteedzere kiredhiti yako muganho kana iyo headroom yakasara pairi. Bhangi rako chete ndiro rinoziva muganho uye rinoshandisa chirevo chakavharwa, saka chero nhamba iyo App yakashandiswa kubva mumeseji yako chete inogona kunge isiriyo. Tarisa chirevo chekadhi rako kuti uone muganhu unowanikwa kwauri.
terms.guide34Body:
Maakaundi ndipo panogara mari yako. Kune marudzi maviri: account yemari, inoratidzwa seBhangi / Cash / Debit Card, uye Kadhi rechikwereti. Unogona kuwedzera mamwe maakaundi, kuatumidza zita, kuvapa chiratidzo, kana kuviga imwe yausingachashandisi.

Kuaccount yemari iyo App inoratidza zvaivepo kusvika kupera kwemwedzi wapfuura, mari yemwedzi uno nemari, uye zvakasara. Kune kadhi rechikwereti rinoratidza izvo zvakabhadharwa kwairi uye zvakabhadharwa kune iyo mwedzi uno, uye chiyero chayo chinoverenga sechimiro chisina kunaka kwenguva yakareba sezvaine chikwereti.

Masara anoitwa kubva pamari yako yekutanga pamwe nezvese zvawakarekodha kubvira. Iyo App haina kumbobata bhangi rako kuti uvatarise.
terms.guide35Body:
Iyo Transaction skrini inonyora mari yaunowana kana mari yezuva rakasarudzwa, mwedzi kana gore. Mutsara wemachipisi unokuita kuti udzikise rondedzero kune imwechete account, uye iyo yakazara yeiyo yakasefa inoratidzwa padivi.

Pfupiso iri pamusoro pemagirazi Kumba: Mari, Mari uye Balance kumaakaundi ako emari, nezvakachajwa kumakadhi ako echikwereti uye zvakabhadharwa kwavari pamutsara wavo wepasi.

Zvirongwa zveApp zvinopawo maonero ezvese zvekutengeserana, kwaunogona kusefa nenguva, sarudza mitsetse yakawanda kamwechete, uye woidzima pamwe chete.
terms.guide36Body:
Pa Android iyo App inogona kuverenga mameseji ekubhengi atove mubhokisi rako rekunyora uye oashandura kuita dhizaini dhizaini. Inokumbira mvumo yeSMS kutanga, uye unogona kuramba. Mameseji anoverengwa pachishandiso chako uye haana kuiswa chero kupi.

Inotarisa hwindo richangoburwa remeseji, inoburitsa huwandu, zuva, mutengesi, ingave mari mukati kana kunze, uye iyo account kana kadhi yakashandiswa, yobva yafembera chikamu kubva kune zita remutengesi. Mharidzo dzisiri dzekutengeserana, senge mapassword enguva imwe chete, mubhadharo wakakundikana, zvitetifomu, zviziviso zvemazuva ekupedzisira uye zvikwereti kana zvikwereti zvinopihwa, zvinopepetwa.

Mari inotorwa muATM inotsikwa nemaune. Mari yako yebhangi uye mari iri muruoko rwako inogara muakaundi imwe chete, saka kubvisa hakufambisi chinhu pakati pavo, uye chaunoshandisa mari pairi ndiyo yekupinda yakakodzera kuve nayo. Kudhirowa mari pakadhi rechikwereti kuri kukwereta, saka iyo ichiri kutengwa kunze kwenyika.

Hapana chinochengetwa kusvika wasimbisa. Unogona kusarudza kana kujekesa zvese, untick mitsara yega yega, uye shandura chikamu usati waunza kunze kwenyika. Mitsara yawakatora kunze inoyeukwa uye haizowedzerwe kaviri.

Iko SMS isingawanikwe unogona kunamira meseji meseji panzvimbo. Zvekupinzwa kunze zvakangonaka semameseji aabva, uye iwe une basa rekuzvitarisa.
terms.guide37Body: Kutengeserana kwakaiswa muzvikamu zvakaita seGroceries, Chikafu, Zvekutakura, Rendi, EMI, mabhiri uye Muhoro. Iwe unogona kuwedzera yako neiyo yakasarudzwa icon uye ruvara, tumidza zita kana kudzima izvo zvawawedzera, uye gadzirisa rondedzero kumashure kune defaults. The Others category haigoni kubviswa, saka hapana chinombosara chisina imba.
terms.guide38Body: Unogona kuseta muganhu wepamwedzi wechero chikamu chemari uye wotarisa zvawakashandisa uchipokana nazvo, kusanganisira kukopa miganhu yemwedzi wapfuura mune ino. Budget igwara kwauri; iyo App haivharidzi kushandisa kana kukumisa kurekodha kutengeserana kunoenda pamusoro peimwe.
terms.guide39Body:
Machati anoratidza kwakaenda mari yako sekuparara kwechikamu, pamwe nemaitiro ekushandisa uye kuenzanisa kwemwedzi nemwedzi. Karenda inoratidza zuva rega rega remwedzi nehwerengedzo yaro, uye nekudzvanya zuva rinoratidza zvinyorwa zvezuva iroro.

Smart Insights inoverenga yako yakarekodhwa data pachishandiso chako uye inonongedza zvinhu zvakaita sebhajeti rauri pedyo nekupfuura, chikamu chakasvetuka zvichienzaniswa nemwedzi wapfuura, kana mwedzi usina mari yakanyorwa. Insights ndeyekutarisa pane zvawakapinda, kwete zano, uye iPrimum chimiro.
terms.guide310Body: Bhuku remari ndiro rakasiyana seti yeakaunti, kutengeserana uye bhajeti, saka iwe unogona kuchengeta, semuenzaniso, marekodhi epamba uye ebhizinesi akasiyana. Iwe unotanga neimwe inonzi Yemunhu, uye iwe unogona kugadzira zvimwe, uzvipe zita, shandura icon yavo, chengetedza iyo yawapedza nayo, kana kudzima. Bhuku rawakavhura chete ndiro rinoratidzwa pese paApp.
terms.guide311Body:
Iyo Zviyeuchidzo nzvimbo yekushandira inovhara mabhiri anodzokororwa, mishonga ine mangwanani, masikati nemanheru madosi, magirosari ari kusvika zuva raanopera, uye zviyeuchidzo zvakajairika. Iwe unogona kuseta kuti kumberi kwaunonyeverwa, inguvai yambiro yezuva nezuva inosvika, uye kuti alarm inorira kwenguva yakareba sei, uye unogona kuyedza alarm chero nguva.

Zviyeuchidzo zviri nyore chete. Kuti munhu anosvika pauri chaizvo zvinoenderana nezvirongwa zvechishandiso chako, mvumo, mamiriro ebhatiri uye masisitimu ekushandisa, saka ndapota usavimbe navo pane chero chinhu chakakosha.
terms.guide312Body:
Iyo Shopping workspace inochengeta yakapusa runyorwa rwezvinhu zvine huwandu hwaunogona kutsvaga uye kukipa sekutengwa.

Iyo Split workspace inoita kuti iwe ugovane mutengo neshamwari uye nemapoka, uchigovanisa mari zvakaenzana, nemari chaiyo, neperesenti, nemasheya kana nekugadzirisa, uye inochengeta rekodhi rekuti ndiani ane chikwereti. Inoda akasaina-akaundi uye iri Premium chimiro. Iyo App inongochengeta rekodhi; haimbofambisi mari pakati pako nemumwe munhu.
terms.guide313Body: Kutsvaga kubva kumusoro kunotarisa pane zvese zvaunoita, zviyeuchidzo, zvinhu zvekutenga uye marongero. Iwe unogona kushandura mari yekuratidzira kubva kumusoro chip, iyo inoshandura kuti mari inoratidzwa sei uye haishandure. Iyo App inowanikwa mumitauro yakawanda. Gwaro iri rinoturikirwawo, ukuwo zvikamu zvemutemo zveMitemo Yekushandisa zvichipihwa muChirungu.
terms.guide314Body: Unogona kushandura chitarisiko cheApp nemadingindira uye wopa chimiro chako chimiro avatar. Dingindira remahara rinogara riripo, uye mamwe anogona kuvhurwa nePrimum kana kurendwa nemadhaimani.
terms.guide315Body:
Madhaimani mubairo we-mu-app usina kukosha kwemari. Izvo hazvigone kutengwa, kutengeswa, kuendeswa kana kuchinjaniswa nemari, uye hazvidzoserwe.

Iwe unozviwana nekusarudza kuona kushambadzira kune mibairo kusvika kumagumo, uye nekukoka shamwari. Pane muganhu wekuti mangani aunogona kuwana kubva kushambadziro zuva rega rega. Yako chiyero uye muganho wezuva nezuva inobatwa uye inotariswa pane yedu server uchishandisa server nguva, saka kuchinja wachi yemudziyo wako hakuzo wedzera izvo zvaunogona kuwana.

Unogona kushandisa madhaimondi paPrimum pass inotora mazuva akati wandei, kana pane zvekuwedzera senge avatar, theme, kana Smart Insights kwenguva yakati. Kupfuura kana kuvhura kwakatengwa nemadhaimani kunopa iwe chimiro chenguva yakatarwa chete, mushure mezvo zvinongopera. Mitengo, mubairo pakushambadzira uye muganho wezuva nezuva unoratidzwa muApp uye unogona kuchinja chero nguva.

Iyo Premium pass inowanwa nemadhaimani inovhura maficha asi haibvise kushambadza. Chete yakabhadharwa Premium haina kushambadzira.
terms.guide316Body:
Imwe neimwe yakasaina account inowana kodhi yayo yekukoka. Kana shamwari ikaisa kodhi yako, mese munogashira madhaimani, zviri pasi pemuganho wekuti vangani vakoka vanopihwa mubairo.

Kodhi inogona kushandiswa kamwe chete pamunhu, haugone kushandisa yako, uye isu tinogona kuramba mibairo patinotenda kuti macode ari kushungurudzwa, semuenzaniso kuburikidza neduplicate kana automated account.
terms.guide317Body:
Kushandisa kwemahara kunochengeta marekodhi ako pachishandiso chako, kuratidza kushambadza, uye kusiya mamwe maficha akakiyiwa. Uyezve inovhura maficha emunhu aunosarudza, uye Premium inovhura zvese, inobvisa kushambadza, uye inogonesa kuwiriranisa kwegore.

Kubhadhara kunoitwa nemaoko neUPI, mushure mezvo unotitumira referensi yekubhadhara uye isu tinomisa account yako. Activation saka haisi pakarepo. Mitengo, zvirongwa zvemukati uye nguva dzekubhadharisa zvinoratidzwa muApp uye zvinogona kuchinja; shanduko hadzina kukanganisa nguva yawakatobhadhara.
terms.guide318Body:
Vashandisi vemahara vanogona kuona banner uye zviziviso zvemuno muzvikamu zveApp, uye vanogona kusarudza kuona mibairo yemavhidhiyo kushambadzira kuti vawane madhaimondi. Kuona kushambadzira kwakapihwa mubairo inogara iri sarudzo yako uye haimbodiwe kushandisa chinhu chauinacho.

Kushambadza kunopihwa nevechitatu mapato uye vari pasi pezvavo zvirevo uye zvakavanzika marongero. Paid Premium inovabvisa.
terms.guide319Body:
NePrimum uye akasaina-akaundi, mabhuku ako emari, kutengeserana, mabhajeti, zviyeuchidzo, zvikamu uye zvakanamirwa mabhiri mapikicha anogona kuwiriranisa kuti iwe utore pane chimwe chishandiso. Sync inoda kubatana kwekushanda uye inogona kunonoka kana kusakwana, saka ndapota usaite sekopi yako chete.

Cloud kuchengetedza kazhinji inochengeta makore maviri apfuura ezvinyorwa zvemazuva. Zvinyorwa zvekare zvinogara pamudziyo wakazvigadzira.

Unogona kusaina pamudziyo mumwe chete panguva; kusaina kune imwe nzvimbo kunopedza chikamu chekutanga.
terms.guide320: 3.20 Chengetedza, kutumira kunze uye kudzima data rako
terms.guide320Body:
Premium inoita kuti uchengetedze faira rekuchengetedza data rako uye woridzoreredza gare gare. Kudzoreredza kunotsiva izvo zvazvino pamudziyo, uye kutarisira faira ibasa rako. Iwe unogona zvakare kutumira kunze kutengeserana kwako sespredishiti kune zuva renji raunosarudza.

Unogona kudzima data rako chero nguva: kubva pachigadzirwa ichi, kubva mugore, kana zvese. Kudzima ndekwechigarire, saka tora backup kutanga kana ungangoda marekodhi zvakare.
terms.guide321Body: Unogona kutarisa kwakawanda kweApp pasina account. Kuchengetedza marekodhi ako, kutumira mameseji, kuwana kana kushandisa madhaimani, uye kuwiriranisa zvese zvinoda kuti iwe usaine, izvo zvaunogona kuita neGoogle, Apple kana email kero nepassword.
terms.guide322Body:
Zvirongwa zveApp zvine Delete account sarudzo. Tinokubvunza kuti sei uchisiya, uye kana wangosimbisa, account inodzima ipapo ipapo: wabuda, haugone kusaina zvakare, uye zvese zvakabatwa pafoni iyoyo zvinodzimwa. Tora backup kutanga kana ungangoda marekodhi.

Chikumbiro chinobva chaenda kune maneja, uyo anobvisa account uye kopi yayo yegore kubva mumarekodhi edu. Kusvikira izvo zvaitika iyo account inoramba yakadzimwa uye isingashandisike. Kana iwe wakaivhara nekukanganisa, nyora kuti utsigire nekukurumidza uye zvingave zvichiita kuti udzose zvakare.

Mari yawakagova muSplit gara neshamwari dzawakagovana nadzo, saka masaramusi avo achiri kuwedzera. Chikonzero chawapa chinochengetwa chisina zita rako, sechiverengero.
